title: Autumn Sapling, Blossom Sapling and Shade
features: Small seasonal saplings preserve rooted twin crowns, warm bark, root-foot walking and their attached anatomical left vine.
Charcoal-violet Shade drifts with a continuous robe tail and joined grey hands; no legs, weapons or detached wisps.
Directional physical vine lashes and spectral touches use full contact/recovery; Shade retains its existing targeted Life Drain with a distinct gathering gesture.
conceptNote: Scenario supplied the initial concept; an OpenAI whole-concept revision corrected sapling vine handedness and removed human beard anatomy. OpenAI authored all complete pixel figures.
actionsNote: Eight facings each. Five unique actions per sapling and six for Shade; the existing special alias selects its Life Drain gathering clip.
cadenceNote: Sapling lashes and Shade touch/drain contact at .4 s and recover through .8 s. Primary Wraith touch/drain now complete their existing .6/.625 s clips at .3/.375 s contact; its art is unchanged. Rules, stats, ranges and FX remain unchanged.
replayNote: Three movement round trips, three natural strikes, one real targeted Life Drain and return to ready.
contactLabel: four engine-timed lash, touch and Life Drain contacts
reviewNotes: Seven mixed-species drafts are preserved but excluded. Fresh single-creature sheets replace them; material identity is checked across every selected facing/action.
Vine attack registration follows brown root feet, never the low lash tip; the full authored figures are copied without deformation.
Plain rear crowns and hoods face away; attached arms, vine and continuous robe remain intact.
